# Kshitiz Raj

> Software engineer at Barclays (Pune, India) building full-stack platforms and event-driven backends, alongside agentic AI systems — multi-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, and reasoning-first architectures.

Kshitiz Raj is a Software Engineer (BA4) at Barclays Bank PLC, previously a Technical Graduate Developer (BA3) at Barclays. He works across backend engineering, cloud infrastructure, and applied machine learning, and builds agentic AI systems as personal projects.

## Experience

- Software Engineer, BA4 — Barclays Bank PLC, Pune (Mar 2025–Current): migrated CI/CD pipelines for ~10 repositories to AWS (CloudFormation, Service Catalog); built Node.js GraphQL APIs; implemented JWT-based auth; optimized SQL Server queries and stored procedures for high-volume reporting; deployed services on Red Hat OpenShift across multiple clusters.
- Technical Graduate Developer, BA3 — Barclays Bank PLC, Pune (Jul 2024–Feb 2025): built XGBoost/LightGBM models forecasting project RAG (Red/Amber/Green) status, improving accuracy from 82% to 96% at 91% precision; ran end-to-end data science workflows (EDA, feature engineering, hypothesis testing); cut ML training time 63% (4hrs to 1.5hrs).

## Projects

- [Jarvis](https://github.com/kraj2503/jarvis): a governed multi-agent AI system (Python, Google ADK, LangChain, Pinecone, FastAPI, A2A) with a centralized root agent for planning, delegation, and context management; parallel/sequential pipelines for healthcare and financial reasoning combining RAG retrieval with validation stages.
- [WorkSync](https://github.com/kraj2503/WorkSync): a modular, event-driven workflow automation platform (TurboRepo, Express, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Supabase, Next.js) with a Kafka-based pipeline for orchestration and a secure multi-tenant backend.
- [Tradosphere](https://github.com/kraj2503/Exchange.git): a cryptocurrency exchange platform inspired by Backpack.exchange, with a separated API/trading-engine architecture, Redis pub/sub, a market-maker bot, and a trade simulator.
- [Muzly](https://muzly.kshitizraj.com/): a social streaming platform (Next.js, NextAuth) for synchronized YouTube watching with a democratic voting system.

## Skills

Cloud/DevOps: AWS, Docker, Red Hat OpenShift, GitLab CI/CD. Frontend: React.js, Next.js, Tailwind CSS. ML: XGBoost, LightGBM, Feature Engineering, TF-IDF.
